dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Fuzzy Colada arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Fuzzy has been observed to be fearful. Noted to be tense and retreat from handlers when they attempted to interact. During his medical exam, he escalated to snapping during an oral exam. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Fuzzy Colada
